natural: shine in the annals of history

meaning.en: So great an achievement that it will be remembered in history.
meaning.zh: 功绩伟大，将永远载入史册，流芳后世。

equivalents: shine in the annals of history

examples.zh: 他们的英雄事迹光照史册。
examples.en: Their heroic deeds will shine in the annals of history.

examples.zh: 这项发明光照史册，影响了整个世界。
examples.en: The invention will go down in history and has changed the world.

usage.en: Formal; predicate or attributive, used in tributes and commemorations.
usage.zh: 较庄重，作谓语或定语，用于颂扬、纪念。

natural: have to get it off one's chest

meaning.en: Feeling one must say what is on one's mind, or one will not be at ease.
meaning.zh: 心里有话，非说出来不痛快。

equivalents: have to get it off one's chest

examples.zh: 这些话我憋了很久，不吐不快。
examples.en: I have held these words in for ages and have to get them off my chest.

examples.zh: 看完那场比赛，球迷们都有不吐不快的感觉。
examples.en: After the match the fans felt they just had to speak their minds.

usage.en: Often a predicate or attributive (不吐不快的话/心情) in a casual tone.
usage.zh: 多作谓语或定语（不吐不快的话），语气较随意。

meaning.en: A poetic picture of spring passing; also something once beautiful that has faded away.
meaning.zh: 流水带走落花，比喻春光逝去或美好的事物消失。

examples.zh: 春末的河边，流水落花，让人生出惜春之情。
examples.en: By the river in late spring, with water flowing and petals falling, one feels sorry to see the spring go.

examples.zh: 旧日繁华都成了流水落花。
examples.en: The old splendour has all drifted away like blossoms on the stream.

usage.en: Literary; used as a scene in poems and essays, and as a metaphor for decline.
usage.zh: 书面语，既是诗文中的景象，也比喻衰败、消逝。

meaning.en: Feeling grief to the highest degree.

examples.zh: 得知老师去世的消息，大家悲痛至极。
examples.en: On hearing of the teacher's death, everyone was overcome with grief.

examples.zh: 她悲痛至极，一句话也说不出来。
examples.en: She was so grief-stricken she couldn't say a word.

usage.en: Predicate; for bereavement or disaster; serious in tone.
usage.zh: 作谓语，多用于丧亲、灾难，语气沉重。

meaning.en: Acting without regard for the real conditions.

equivalents: ignore the facts on the ground

examples.zh: 盲目扩张，不顾实际，公司最终陷入困境。
examples.en: Expanding blindly and ignoring reality, the company ended up in trouble.

examples.zh: 计划要从实际出发，不能不顾实际。
examples.en: Plans must start from reality and cannot ignore it.

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial; criticism of unrealistic plans or targets.
usage.zh: 作谓语或状语，批评脱离实际的计划、目标。

meaning.en: Each person taking charge of his own share of the duty.
meaning.zh: 每个人承担各自应负的责任。

equivalents: each takes responsibility for their part

examples.zh: 项目组分工明确，大家各负其责。
examples.en: The project team has clear roles and each member is responsible for their part.

examples.zh: 安全工作要各负其责，层层落实。
examples.en: Safety work needs each person to carry their own responsibility, level by level.

usage.en: Formal; predicate, common in work and management.
usage.zh: 较正式，作谓语，常见于工作和管理。

literal: detach from · leave · the masses · crowd
natural: out of touch with the people

meaning.en: Cut off from ordinary people and their concerns.
meaning.zh: 离开群众，不了解他们的想法和需要。

equivalents: out of touch with ordinary people

examples.zh: 干部不能脱离群众，要多下基层。
examples.en: Officials mustn't lose touch with the people and should go to the grassroots more.

examples.zh: 脱离群众的政策很难执行。
examples.en: Policies cut off from the people are hard to carry out.

usage.en: Mostly political and official language; critical in tone.
usage.zh: 多用于政治和官方语境，含批评意味。

antonyms: 从群众中来，到群众中去

meaning.en: Anxious not to fall behind others.
meaning.zh: 只怕比别人慢、比别人差。

examples.zh: 家长们唯恐落后，纷纷给孩子报补习班。
examples.en: Parents, afraid their children will fall behind, are signing them up for tutoring.

examples.zh: 大家唯恐落后，争着交作业。
examples.en: Afraid of being the last, everyone hurried to hand in their homework.

usage.en: Usually a predicate or adverbial; 恐 is kǒng, 唯 is wéi.
usage.zh: 多作谓语或状语，常带无奈或紧张的意味。

meaning.en: To take no notice of someone at all.
meaning.zh: 对人或事不理会，不答应。

examples.zh: 无论他怎么解释，她都不理不睬。
examples.en: However he explained, she just ignored him.

examples.zh: 对这种广告电话，不理不睬就好了。
examples.en: With these ad calls, just ignore them.

usage.en: Predicate; colloquial; 睬 is cǎi.
usage.zh: 作谓语，口语色彩较强，“睬”读 cǎi。

meaning.en: To take the best part and leave the rest.
meaning.zh: 吸取好的、有价值的部分。

examples.zh: 学习传统文化要取其精华，去其糟粕。
examples.en: In learning traditional culture, take the best and discard the dross.

examples.zh: 他博采众长，取其精华，形成了自己的风格。
examples.en: He drew on many schools, took the best of each and formed a style of his own.

usage.en: Usually paired with 去其糟粕; often in talks on culture and learning.
usage.zh: 常与“去其糟粕”连用，多见于谈论文化、学习。

meaning.en: Behaving honestly and decently, with high moral standards.

examples.zh: 他作风正派，同事们都很信任他。
examples.en: He is upright in conduct and colleagues trust him.

examples.zh: 选拔干部要看是否作风正派。
examples.en: In selecting officials one looks at whether their conduct is upright.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; often about officials and teachers.
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语，常用于干部、教师。

literal: pull in · restrain · sharp edge · point

meaning.en: To hold back one's brilliance and not show off.
meaning.zh: 不再显露自己的才能和锐气。

examples.zh: 初到新单位，他收敛锋芒，认真学习。
examples.en: New to the workplace, he kept a low profile and learned diligently.

examples.zh: 有才华的人也需要懂得收敛锋芒。
examples.en: Talented people also need to know how to hold their sharpness back.

usage.en: Verb-object phrase; used for talented or outspoken people.
usage.zh: 动宾短语，多用于有才华或锋芒外露的人。

meaning.en: Done so skilfully that nobody can see how.
meaning.zh: 做得巧妙，看不出任何痕迹。

examples.zh: 她不露痕迹地把话题转开了。
examples.en: She steered the conversation elsewhere without anyone noticing.

examples.zh: 修复师把裂缝补得不露痕迹。
examples.en: The restorer mended the crack without leaving a trace.

usage.en: Usually adverbial (不露痕迹地…) or complement.
usage.zh: 多作状语（不露痕迹地……）或补语。

literal: not at all · have no · omission · slip

meaning.en: Complete, with nothing missed.
meaning.zh: 全部包括，一点也没有漏掉。

examples.zh: 请把情况毫无遗漏地汇报给我。
examples.en: Please report the situation to me in full, leaving nothing out.

examples.zh: 清单列得毫无遗漏。
examples.en: The list is complete, with nothing left out.

usage.en: Adverbial or complement; used in work and reports.
usage.zh: 作状语或补语，多用于工作汇报。

meaning.en: Keeping at something right to the end.

equivalents: stick it out to the end

examples.zh: 只要开始了，就要坚持到底。
examples.en: Once you have started, you must see it through.

examples.zh: 马拉松比赛，他咬牙坚持到底。
examples.en: In the marathon he gritted his teeth and kept going to the end.

usage.en: Verb phrase; common in advice and encouragement.
usage.zh: 动词性短语，常见于劝勉、鼓励。

meaning.en: To value time and use it well.

equivalents: make the most of one's time

examples.zh: 青春短暂，我们要珍惜光阴。
examples.en: Youth is short and we should treasure our time.

examples.zh: 他珍惜光阴，每天坚持读书。
examples.en: He treasures his time and reads every day.

usage.en: Verb-object; common in advice for the young.
usage.zh: 动宾短语，常用于劝勉年轻人。

meaning.en: Standing together and treating each other kindly.

examples.zh: 我们班同学团结友爱，像一家人。
examples.en: The students of our class are united and caring, like one family.

examples.zh: 学校提倡同学之间团结友爱。
examples.en: The school encourages classmates to be united and kind to each other.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; typical of school mottos and slogans.
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语，常见于校训和标语。

meaning.en: Working hard and keen to learn.

examples.zh: 他从小勤奋好学，成绩一直名列前茅。
examples.en: He has been studious since childhood and always near the top of the class.

examples.zh: 老师表扬小明勤奋好学。
examples.en: The teacher praised Xiao Ming for being diligent and eager to learn.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; for students and learners. 好 is hào.
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语，用于学生和学习者。“好”读 hào。

meaning.en: Willing to pay any price to reach a goal.
meaning.zh: 为了达到目的，不怕付出任何代价。

examples.zh: 救援队不惜代价寻找失踪者。
examples.en: The rescue team searched for the missing at all costs.

examples.zh: 为了拿到订单，他不惜代价。
examples.en: To win the order he was ready to pay any price.

usage.en: Usually an adverbial (不惜代价地…); may be positive or negative.
usage.zh: 多作状语（不惜代价地……），可褒可贬。

meaning.en: Natural, free and easy in bearing.
meaning.zh: 行为动作自然大方，不拘束。

examples.zh: 他举止洒脱，给人留下了深刻印象。
examples.en: His easy manner left a deep impression.

examples.zh: 她举止洒脱，毫不扭捏。
examples.en: She carries herself with ease and no affectation.

usage.en: Predicate; describes bearing and style.
usage.zh: 作谓语，形容人的举止风度。

meaning.en: Having a bright, striking air that stands out.
meaning.zh: 神情气质出众，与众不同。

examples.zh: 这位年轻人神采不凡，一看就是干大事的人。
examples.en: The young man has a striking bearing and looks born for great things.

examples.zh: 画中人物神采不凡。
examples.en: The figure in the painting has a distinguished air.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; describes a person's looks and spirit.
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语，形容人的神采气质。

meaning.en: Having talent so great that people are amazed.

examples.zh: 这位少年作曲家才华惊人。
examples.en: The young composer is astonishingly gifted.

examples.zh: 她才华惊人，年纪轻轻就拿了大奖。
examples.en: She is brilliantly talented and won a major prize at a young age.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; praising artists and scholars.
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语，称赞艺术家、学者。

meaning.en: Having an easy, elegant manner.

examples.zh: 他年轻时风度潇洒，很受欢迎。
examples.en: In his youth he was dashing and popular.

examples.zh: 风度潇洒的主持人赢得了观众的喜爱。
examples.en: The elegant host won the audience's affection.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; for men and public figures.
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语，多形容男士或公众人物。

meaning.en: Holding office honestly, refusing bribes and personal gain.

examples.zh: 包拯为官清廉，百姓称他“包青天”。
examples.en: Bao Zheng was an incorruptible official, whom the people called Bao Qingtian.

examples.zh: 他一生为官清廉，家里没有积蓄。
examples.en: He was upright throughout his career and left no savings.

usage.en: Formal; 为 is wéi here. Used for officials, past and present.
usage.zh: 较庄重；“为”读 wéi，用于古今官员。

meaning.en: A country with great economic, military and political strength.
meaning.zh: 国家的经济和军事等实力很强大。

examples.zh: 唐代国力强盛，万国来朝。
examples.en: In the Tang the country was at its height and envoys came from everywhere.

examples.zh: 国力强盛，国家才有尊严。
examples.en: A country is respected only when it is strong.

usage.en: Formal; predicate, used in history and current affairs.
usage.zh: 较正式，作谓语，用于历史和时事。

meaning.en: Giving or helping without wanting anything back.
meaning.zh: 付出帮助时不要求得到好处。

equivalents: give without asking for anything back

examples.zh: 志愿者默默奉献，不求回报。
examples.en: The volunteers give quietly and expect nothing in return.

examples.zh: 父母对子女的爱是不求回报的。
examples.en: A parent's love for their children asks for nothing back.

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial; often after 默默奉献/无私付出.
usage.zh: 作谓语或状语，常与“默默奉献、无私付出”连用。

meaning.en: Not fussing over ornament; simple and natural.

examples.zh: 他的文章语言朴素，不事雕琢。
examples.en: His prose is plain and unadorned.

examples.zh: 这位工匠做的家具不事雕琢，却很耐看。
examples.en: The craftsman's furniture is unornamented but wears well to the eye.

usage.en: Formal or literary; for writing, art and style. 琢 is zhuó.
usage.zh: 偏书面语，多用于文章、艺术和风格。“琢”读 zhuó。

meaning.en: Having seen and heard a great deal.
meaning.zh: 见到的听到的很多，阅历广。

examples.zh: 他走南闯北，见闻丰富。
examples.en: Having travelled all over, he has seen and heard a great deal.

examples.zh: 多读书、多旅行能让人见闻丰富。
examples.en: Reading and travelling widely makes one well informed.

usage.en: Predicate; often follows travel or reading.
usage.zh: 作谓语，常与旅行、读书连用。

meaning.en: Having wide knowledge and deep insight.

examples.zh: 这位老教授见识渊博，什么问题都难不倒他。
examples.en: The old professor is deeply learned and no question stumps him.

examples.zh: 见识渊博的人往往谦虚。
examples.en: The truly learned are often modest.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; 见识 is jiàn shi.
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语，用于学者、长辈。

meaning.en: Having gone through many hardships.

examples.zh: 历经艰辛，他们终于登上了山顶。
examples.en: After much hardship they finally reached the summit.

examples.zh: 她历经艰辛才把三个孩子养大。
examples.en: She went through many hardships to raise three children.

usage.en: Usually opens a sentence or acts as an adverbial.
usage.zh: 多用于句首或作状语。

meaning.en: Having wide outlook and not being narrow.

examples.zh: 出国交流让学生们眼界开阔。
examples.en: Study trips abroad broadened the students' horizons.

examples.zh: 他眼界开阔，不拘泥于一城一地。
examples.en: He has a wide outlook and isn't confined to one place.

usage.en: Predicate; often with 让…眼界开阔.
usage.zh: 作谓语，常用“让……眼界开阔”。

meaning.en: Moving and acting calmly, without haste.
meaning.zh: 行为动作镇定、不慌不忙。

examples.zh: 她举止从容，一点也不紧张。
examples.en: She is calm in her manner and not at all nervous.

examples.zh: 面试时他举止从容，赢得了考官的好感。
examples.en: In the interview he was composed and impressed the examiners.

usage.en: Predicate; 从 is cóng here.
usage.zh: 作谓语。

meaning.en: Looking calm and collected, even in a tense moment.

examples.zh: 遇到突发情况，他神态镇定，指挥大家撤离。
examples.en: In the emergency he stayed calm and directed everyone out.

examples.zh: 她神态镇定地走上了讲台。
examples.en: She walked calmly to the lectern.

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial (神态镇定地…).
usage.zh: 作谓语或状语（神态镇定地……）。

meaning.en: Having a solid base that is hard to shake.

examples.zh: 这家百年老店根基稳固，经得起风浪。
examples.en: The century-old shop is firmly established and rides out storms.

examples.zh: 打好基础，才能根基稳固。
examples.en: Only by laying a good base can one be on a firm footing.

usage.en: Predicate; for companies, families, theories, skills.
usage.zh: 作谓语，用于企业、家族、理论、技能等。

meaning.en: Having great strength and influence.

examples.zh: 这家集团势力雄厚，分公司遍布全国。
examples.en: The group is very powerful, with branches all over the country.

examples.zh: 他背后有势力雄厚的家族支持。
examples.en: He has a powerful family behind him.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; for firms, clans, factions.
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语，用于企业、家族、派系。

meaning.en: Not easily changed or overturned.

examples.zh: 他的信念不易动摇。
examples.en: His belief is not easily shaken.

examples.zh: 这家企业在行业中的地位不易动摇。
examples.en: The firm's place in the industry is not easily shaken.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive (不易动摇的…).
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语（不易动摇的……）。

meaning.en: Showing no panic at all.

examples.zh: 火灾发生时，老师毫不慌乱，带着学生有序撤离。
examples.en: When the fire broke out the teacher kept calm and led the students out in order.

examples.zh: 他毫不慌乱地回答了所有问题。
examples.en: He answered every question without the least fluster.

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial (毫不慌乱地…).
usage.zh: 作谓语或状语（毫不慌乱地……）。

literal: indifferent · so · conduct oneself · in the world

meaning.en: Facing the world with a calm and unattached attitude.
meaning.zh: 以平淡超脱的态度对待世事。

examples.zh: 经历了许多事后，他学会了淡然处世。
examples.en: After many experiences he learned to take life calmly.

examples.zh: 淡然处世，不与人争。
examples.en: Take life calmly and do not compete with others.

usage.en: Verb phrase; 处 is chǔ (to deal with). Often advice or a character description.
usage.zh: 动词性短语，“处”读 chǔ，多作劝勉或人物描述。

meaning.en: Thinking something beneath one's notice.

examples.zh: 他对这些小事不屑一提。
examples.en: He wouldn't deign to mention such trivia.

examples.zh: 这点成绩，在他看来不屑一提。
examples.en: In his view these results are not worth mentioning.

usage.en: Predicate; scornful or very modest depending on context.
usage.zh: 作谓语，因语境可表轻视，也可表示谦虚。

meaning.en: Willing to endure hard conditions and hard work.
meaning.zh: 不害怕艰苦，愿意付出辛劳。

equivalents: ready to put up with hardship

examples.zh: 这孩子不怕吃苦，什么活都肯干。
examples.en: The child isn't afraid of hardship and will do any job.

examples.zh: 做研究要不怕吃苦。
examples.en: Doing research means not being afraid of hard work.

usage.en: Predicate; colloquial and common in encouragement.
usage.zh: 作谓语，口语色彩，常用于鼓励。

meaning.en: Looking brave, spirited and full of vigour.

examples.zh: 这个年轻的军官英气勃勃。
examples.en: The young officer is full of dash.

examples.zh: 画中少年英气勃勃，目光炯炯。
examples.en: The youth in the picture is spirited, with bright, piercing eyes.

usage.en: Descriptive; predicate or attributive. 勃勃 is bó bó.
usage.zh: 描写性词语，作谓语或定语。

meaning.en: Showing one's gifts in a brilliant way.
meaning.zh: 才能充分展现，光彩夺目。

examples.zh: 这位青年诗人才华焕发，作品屡获好评。
examples.en: The young poet brims with talent, and his work is repeatedly praised.

examples.zh: 舞台上，她才华焕发。
examples.en: On stage she sparkles with talent.

usage.en: Predicate; for artists, scholars and performers.
usage.zh: 作谓语，用于艺术家、学者和表演者。

natural: lovely scenery of hills and rivers

meaning.en: Beautiful mountains and rivers.

examples.zh: 这里山川秀美，每年吸引大量游客。
examples.en: The scenery here is lovely and attracts many tourists every year.

examples.zh: 江南山川秀美，物产丰饶。
examples.en: Jiangnan has beautiful landscapes and abundant produce.

usage.en: Descriptive; common in travel writing and local introductions.
usage.zh: 描写性词语，常见于游记和地方介绍。

meaning.en: Not slacking off in the least.

equivalents: not let up for a moment

examples.zh: 考试前夕，他仍然毫不懈怠地复习。
examples.en: On the eve of the exam he kept revising without letting up.

examples.zh: 医护人员毫不懈怠地守在岗位上。
examples.en: The medical staff stayed at their posts without letting up.

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial (毫不懈怠地…).
usage.zh: 作谓语或状语（毫不懈怠地……）。

meaning.en: Carrying a deep message beneath the surface.

examples.zh: 这则寓言寓意深刻，值得反复品味。
examples.en: The fable is deeply meaningful and worth savouring again and again.

examples.zh: 这部电影的结尾寓意深刻。
examples.en: The film's ending carries a deep message.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; for fables, films, works.
usage.zh: 作谓语或定语，用于寓言、电影、作品。

meaning.en: Choosing words that are exactly right.

examples.zh: 这篇评论用词精当，一针见血。
examples.en: The review is precisely worded and hits the mark.

examples.zh: 他写文章用词精当，从不啰嗦。
examples.en: He writes with apt diction and never rambles.

usage.en: Predicate; used in appraising writing and speeches.
usage.zh: 作谓语，用于评价文章和讲话。
